MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 24

2. Solve for x: x + 9 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 9
   C. 4
   D. 5

3. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 40
   C. 41
   D. 13

4. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 8
   C. 17
   D. 0

5. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 13
   C. 37
   D. 36

6. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 48
   C. 24
   D. 156

7. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 26
   C. 10
   D. 25

8. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 49
   C. 50
   D. 7

9. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 36

10. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 49
   C. 41
   D. 43

11. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 65
   C. 0
   D. 64

12. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 90

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
